messages.text:
"Create a high-speed, third-person 3D obstacle platformer inspired by knock-out party games (Stumble Guys style) with bright, colorful cartoon visuals, bouncy arcade physics, and a responsive virtual joystick with Jump and Dive buttons.

CORE GAMEPLAY @COMMENT_BODY@ MECHANICS:
- Player Character: A cute, chunky low-poly runner with bouncy, slightly ragdoll physics. Responsive steering, running, jumping, and forward diving.
- Level Design: A vibrant floating obstacle track with 3 distinct zones:
  1. Zone 1: Giant spinning padded sweepers and rotating circular platforms.
  2. Zone 2: Launch pads, bouncing bumper mushrooms, and rolling dodgeballs rolling down an incline.
  3. Zone 3: Disappearing drop-floor tiles and swinging pendulum hammers leading to the finish line.
- Fail State: Falling off the edge triggers a comedic cartoon 'boing' sound, bouncing the player back to the last activated checkpoint instantly.
- Win State: Reaching the victory podium triggers a massive shower of golden confetti, an arcade victory sound, and a celebratory dance animation.

PERSONALIZED HUD @COMMENT_BODY@ POP-UP MESSAGE TRIGGERS:
Display prominent, high-contrast arcade speech bubbles and top-screen banners with customized text at specific milestones:
- Game Start Banner: \"Let's roll! Dad's cheering for you every step of the way!\"
- Checkpoint 1 Trigger: \"Remember those living room wrestling matches? Nobody laughs harder or tackles better than you! Miss you like crazy, buddy!\"
- Checkpoint 2 Trigger: \"Undefeated Legend! The absolute greatest 5-year-old Fortnite player in history—hands down!\"
- Checkpoint 3 Trigger: \"You are my entire world. No matter the distance, Dad is always right here in your corner.\"
- Fall / Respawn Quip: \"Pop right back up, champ! We don't stay down!\"
- Victory Podium Screen: \"VICTORY ROYALE! You crushed it! I love you endlessly, kiddo. Always and forever.\"

AESTHETICS @COMMENT_BODY@ PERFORMANCE:
- Clean low-poly geometry, bright saturated colors, soft lighting, and high frame rate performance for mobile devices.
- Include a mute toggle, clear touch controls on-screen, and a giant 'Play Again' button at the final screen.
STRICT SYSTEM CONSTRAINTS (DO NOT DEVIATE):
- ZERO procedural generation. The track layout must be 100% fixed and identical on every playthrough.
- ZERO online multiplayer, netcode, or matchmaking. Single-player only. 
- ZERO complex lighting. Use strictly flat-shaded, unlit materials to guarantee 60fps performance on mobile.
- LOCK the camera to a rigid third-person follow perspective. Do not allow camera clipping through walls.
- FORBID any text generation. Only use the exact custom text strings provided in the prompt.
"

Implemented the game in `index.html` as a fixed, single-player 3D platformer.

It includes a colorful low-poly course with three obstacle zones, checkpoint banners, respawning, a third-person follow camera, touch joystick and Jump/Dive controls, mute toggle, synthesized arcade sounds, and a victory screen with confetti and **Play Again**. The course layout is deterministic; it uses unlit materials and has no multiplayer.

**Verification:** Opened it in a browser, confirmed the scene rendered and the game progressed through a checkpoint to the victory screen. Reload showed no console errors or warnings.

Three.js is loaded from jsDelivr, so the game needs an internet connection to load that dependency.
